note: Achievements and dynasty milestones (roadmap item 16; core/game/game_achievements.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). A milestone is a count about the whole dynasty (`count`, one of GameAchievements.COUNTS) reaching a `goal` (`goal_from: house_max` takes the goal from the game: every level of every house track). Once reached it is kept for good on the dynasty (`achievements`: the generation, the year and the heir), even if the count later falls. A milestone may award a house title (`title`): the title's own condition is `{achievement: id}`. Reaching is asked for by the screens, with the titles, never by the rules of a life, so the autopilot reaches nothing and no die is drawn.
